nom: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UV Hydra Sunscreen SPF 50 with Hyaluronic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination skin frequently describe this sunscreen as greasy, tacky, or heavy, though a few report it did not break them out or look shiny once absorbed.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently describe it as hydrating and comfortable, with some calling it ideal specifically for dry or severe dry skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several say it is calming, fragrance-light, and non-irritating, while others report it caused redness, irritation, or breakouts on their sensitive areas.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination/mix-to-oily skin generally find it too greasy for warm weather but appreciate how it performs under makeup.
segments.mature: A reviewer with dry, mature skin praises its texture, glow, and lack of pilling under makeup or skincare, calling it one of her favorites after trying many brands.
segments.normal: Reviewers who do not specify a skin concern mostly describe the formula as lightweight, non-greasy, and easy to layer under makeup.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it as part of an anti-aging routine describe it as a light layer suitable under makeup and appreciate the SPF for daily sun protection; no negative aging-specific effects are reported.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report strong hydration and no tightness or peeling; one review notes it helped compensate for a compromised moisture barrier in winter.
concerns.redness: Reports are mixed: several sensitive-skin users say it caused no irritation or stinging, but at least two describe new or worsened redness and irritation after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a disrupted moisture barrier reports the hyaluronic acid formula gave needed hydration and comfort; no other barrier-specific complaints appear.
concerns.spots: Reviewers describing sun protection use report feeling adequately shielded with no burning, though few comment on visible pigmentation/spot changes.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and praise it as non-comedogenic; however, at least two reviewers (including one teenager) describe new breakouts or small pimples after use.
concerns.oiliness: Many reviewers with oily-leaning skin find it leaves a greasy, shiny, or tacky finish that sits on top of the skin, while others insist it is not greasy at all and absorbs quickly.

aspects.libelle: Convenient pump and travel size packaging

extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin and one of the main reasons I purchased this sunscreen was because it was suitable for sensitive skin. Its not. Although I do love rhe texture and it does leave no white cast and is hydrating, it emphasized redness on my cheeks and thats where im more sensitive. I did see notice little breakouts since I started using this sunscreen. Will be returning.

extraits.titre: Good but not for oily skin or summer
extraits.texte: I have mix to oily skin and this sunscreen makes me feel so greasy! I think this would be great for dry skin only. However, i love how it looks under makeup

I have finally found a sunscreen for my face that does a great job protecting my skin from the sun AND doesn't cause breakouts! I have dry, sensitive skin and every single sunscreen I have ever tried has caused me to breakout with pimples. The Anthelios UV Hydra lotion is the perfect sunscreen for me! It has no fragrance, layers nicely with my other face products and makeup, and it hydrates my face without being oily and greasy.

Moisturizing, lightweight and NOT greasy/oily! I have super sensitive skin and this does not break my face out. Thick enough but not too thick. Goes on like butter and my skin just soaks it all in! This will be great with spring/summer coming and for every day use!

I'm so happy that I received this sunscreen to try from Influenster! I've been searching for a good sunscreen and I believe I have found my match. I tried a sample size of La Roche-Posay SPF 50 Mineral Anthelios Light Fluid Sunscreen, but I didn't like the fact that it left a white cast on my face. This one however (the Anthelios UV Hydra sunscreen) didn't give me that problem. It really did seem like an invisible sunscreen. I also LOVE that it has hyaluronic acid in it and that it is super moisturizing, because my face has been extremely dry this winter. I don't know if it's the cold weather or what, but my moisture barrier has been messed up and I need all the hydration I can get. This has felt so good on my face and I'm really happy that it's SPF 50 and not something lower. Thanks so much Influenster, I'm super pleased with this product!!!!!!

I go through a lot of sunscreen and my skin type is dry, mature. That being said, I've used tons of brands, both tinted and non tinted and from different countries. Some things I look for are: UVA/UVB protection; white cast on skin; pilling of product and how it works with other products and beneath makeup; how moisturizing it feels on my face; and definitely if it is irritating and stinging. This has to be one of my recent favorites! It has a bit of thicker texture, reminiscent of the Lipikar formula and leaves a nice glow to the skin. It has a mild sunscreen scent and didn't appear to leave a white cast on my skin. It didn't pill with my skincare or my makeup

Feels light and slightly greasy on your skin. Smells like sunscreen. My daughter tried it, and did not like it. It broke out her skin. This is not something I would go out of my way to buy, but enjoyed trying it.
